start.title: Who Sinned?
start.text:
You sit in the dust, begging.
Disciples ask, "Who sinned?"

choices.feedback: John 9:3 — Jesus answered that neither the man nor his parents sinned, but that the works of God might be displayed in him.

curse_consequence.title: Be Still
curse_consequence.text:
Anger will not heal you.
Listen.

reveal.title: God's Works Revealed
reveal.text:
"Neither this man nor his parents."
"God's works shall be seen."

choices.feedback: John 9:3 — Jesus said that the man's blindness was so that the works of God might be displayed in him.

doubt_consequence.title: Hold On
doubt_consequence.text:
His voice is kind.
Hope a little.

mud.title: Mud on Your Eyes
mud.text:
He spits on the ground, makes clay.
His hand finds your face.

choices.feedback: John 9:6 — Jesus spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, and spread the mud on the blind man's eyes.

pull_consequence.title: Be Still
pull_consequence.text:
His touch is gentle.
Let him work.

wipe_consequence.title: Trust His Hand
wipe_consequence.text:
Do not undo his work.
Wait.

send.title: Go to Siloam
send.text:
"Go, wash in the pool of Siloam."
The way is long.

choices.feedback: John 9:7 — Jesus told the man to go, wash in the pool of Siloam.

wash.title: The Pool of Siloam
wash.text:
Water in your hands.
You bring it to your eyes.

choices.feedback: John 9:7 — The man went and washed, and came back seeing.

shut_consequence.title: Open Your Eyes
shut_consequence.text:
He sent you to see.
Lift them.

see.title: You Can See
see.text:
Sky. Stone. Your own hands.
You weep, laughing.

choices.feedback: John 9:11 — The man told the Pharisees that a man called Jesus made mud, anointed his eyes, and told him to go to Siloam and wash.

hide_consequence.title: Speak Out
hide_consequence.text:
Do not hide his work.
Tell them.

pharisees.title: Pharisees Question You
pharisees.text:
They glare. "Who opened your eyes?"
The room is cold.

choices.feedback: John 9:11 — The man answered the Pharisees, saying, "The man called Jesus made mud and anointed my eyes and said to me, 'Go to Siloam and wash'; so I went and washed and received my sight."

lie_consequence.title: Speak Truth
lie_consequence.text:
Truth set you free.
Name him.

silent_consequence.title: Find Your Voice
silent_consequence.text:
He gave you sight.
Give him your words.

testify.title: One Thing I Know
testify.text:
"I was blind. Now I see."
The light stays with you.
